data.one_liner: Iconsax icon set for Flutter with over 6000 icons in 6 different styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Iconsax icon collection for Flutter applications, offering thousands of icons across six distinct styles.
use_when: You want to use the Iconsax icon set in your Flutter application.
Your design requires multiple style variations for icons.
avoid_when: You prefer using standard Material Design or Cupertino icons.
You need an icon set from a different provider like FontAwesome.
strengths: Contains over 6000 icons across 6 different styles.
Easy to integrate into Flutter apps.
weaknesses: Few recent changelog details regarding maintenance.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the widely used Font Awesome icon set instead of Iconsax.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the Lucide icon set for Flutter.
